# Nemyu NX2 switches
#
# One "NAME=VALUE" per line; lines starting with '#' are ignored. Nemyu reads this file at
# startup, so the EDEN_NX2_* switches also work for a launch from the GUI. Files are read in
# this order, and a later file wins over an earlier one:
#
#   1. nx2_switches.txt next to nemyu.exe / nemyu-cli.exe (Windows only)
#   2. %APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, then %APPDATA%\nemyu\nx2_switches.txt
#      (Linux/macOS: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nemyu)
#   3. user\nx2_switches.txt in a portable install
#
# A variable already set in the real environment always wins over every file. Only names that
# start with EDEN_NX2_ are taken, plus the few Selevet names listed at the end. Copy this file to
# one of the places above and uncomment a line to use it; each switch is described next to its
# getenv in the source.
